content:
In addition to Amazon's updated early autumn Prime Day mega-sale, and the launch promotion of the brand-new Beats 360 Over-Ear Headphones bundled with a detachable Cushion Kit at 20% off, the most eye-catching Apple deal this weekend is the AirPods Pro 3 continuing to be slashed by US$50.

Alongside early bird discounts on the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, there's also a clearance deal of US$200 off the Apple Watch Ultra 3. On the Mac side, the M5 MacBook Air has a US$150 price cut ready to go, while the newly released Mac Studio and Mac mini offer up to US$50 off. Together with a wide range of iPhone 18 Pro accessories and cases, check out the full deals below.
